source.note: The directory renders organisation details from these public JSON endpoints; there are no separate HTML detail pages. Detail records were fetched for every organisation and contain the same fields as the list. Source categories (type/subtype) are kept as reference only.

rules: Names are preserved exactly as published, except leading/trailing and doubled spaces (flagged).
Nothing is invented: missing values are null and flagged.

Faculty listed by the source are faculty associations (as published). They are NOT society Heads or administrators in Thapar SNS, and nothing about society leadership or permissions is inferred from them.

Faculty details come ONLY from https://www.thapar.edu/faculties and the official department or school faculty pages it redirects to (owner decisions 2026-10-25); officially published values are verified. A dataset person is linked to an official record by exact institutional email, or by the same name in the same department (verification.matchBasis). A same-name entry in another department is needs_review. Without an official record the status is no_official_record. Official values are kept next to the published ones (verification.official, verification.discrepancies); nothing is replaced.

Redactions (owner-approved 2026-10-25): faculty photo links are removed (unused personal data) and personal (non-@thapar.edu) faculty email addresses are removed; faculty[].redactions records each one.
Logo references are links only. Reuse rights are unknown; nothing is downloaded or hot-linked.

Owner decision (2026-10-25): information published on the official Thapar website (including studentsocieties.thapar.edu, the institute's official student-activities portal) and on official department or school pages is treated as verified (review.sourceStatus = official_published). This grants nobody any application permission.
review.appReview = pending: an imported society stays hidden, inactive and awaiting its first Head until an admin activates it in the application; this is a workflow step, not a doubt about the data.

review.questionableFields lists fields where the official source contradicts itself or is malformed (e.g. one organisation's email or website repeated on another, text that is not a URL); they are kept raw and flagged for review.
review.possibleDuplicateOf lists other keys that may be the same organisation; records are never merged automatically.
